title: Store download badge assembles on black
summary: A black download badge builds piece by piece on black: the rounded outline scales up, the store mark fades in, then the two label lines rise word by word inside the frame. It holds, then fades and shrinks out.
use_when: a 2-4 s download CTA insert at the end of a mobile app film
an end-card overlay that tells viewers where to get the app
a silent, monochrome sign-off that must not compete with the logo

look.type_style: medium grotesk, sentence case, normal tracking; small eyebrow line ~11 % H above a large label line ~18 % H, left aligned beside the mark

sfx.event: label words rise in, one per word

structure.shot: one rounded-rectangle download badge centred on black: thin grey outline, store mark left, 3-word eyebrow over a 2-word label
structure.camera: static (no camera move; the badge itself scales 0.85→1.00 on entry and ~1.00→0.90 on exit)
structure.motion: f0 black; outline fades and scales 0.85→1.00 f1–f6, springs.ui (no overshoot at 1 fr); mark fades in f4–f8; words rise from below inside the badge clip with fade, stagger ~2 fr, first word f7, last f11, mask-rise on springs.ui (no overshoot seen), all settled f24; hold f24–f80; exit f80–f84 fade to black + scale to ~0.90, easings.inExpo 4 fr; black f84–f90

params.mark: store or platform glyph shown at the left of the badge
params.eyebrow: small line above the label, ≤ 4 words (where to get it)
params.label: large line, ≤ 2 words (the store name)
params.outline: badge stroke colour, grey on black by default

notes: Single 3 s shot, no cuts, silent. Entrance timings measured from 30 fps strips of the local source (1 fr); frames 84–89 are black. The badge was ordered outline → mark → words. Catalogue hint device-phone not visible: no device on screen. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured. Proposed terms (not used as ids): badge-assemble, shrink-fade-out.
